description.zh: 全球加速实例的带宽峰值，单位为Mbps，取值：**10**。
description.en: The maximum bandwidth of the GA instance. Unit: Mbit/s. Set the value to **10**.
The ID of the GA instance.

description.zh:
全球加速实例所在的地域。 

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the GA instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 修改全球加速实例的带宽

descriptions.zh:
## API描述

该接口不支持修改预付费全球加速实例的带宽。
descriptions.en:
## Usage notes

You cannot call this operation to modify the maximum bandwidth of a subscription GA instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc modify-global-acceleration-instance-spec --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --global-acceleration-instance-id ga-32s33s0000 --bandwidth 10 --region cn-hangzhou
